name: collabsmap
description: Discover travel brand creator collaborations and map active opportunities by destination, offer type, and social platform.

interface.longDescription: Discover active travel brand collaborations, gifted stays, paid campaigns, and press trips. Filter public opportunities by destination and social platform, explore them on a map, and continue applications on CollabsMap.
defaultPrompt: Find travel creator collaborations in Japan, especially gifted stays.
Show me paid travel brand opportunities that accept TikTok creators.
Explore active creator opportunities on a map.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It provides public opportunity discovery; any compensation for a collaboration is arranged between the creator and brand, outside this integration.

positive.description: Find collabs for a city through the place-reach rule, then show the returned locations and collabs on the map. Live counts are not fixed assertions.
positive.prompt: Find travel creator collaborations in Tokyo and show them on a map.
positive.tools_triggered: search_opportunities_map with place=Tokyo, then render_opportunities_map with the returned composite pin_ids and the same filters.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve place=Tokyo. Map only returned results, with valid coordinates and canonical CollabsMap listing/application links. Show the place scope and any returned km_from_place for nearby venues or towns. If place lookup falls back to pin-name matching, explain the returned note; do not imply a complete nearby search. If no results are found, explain that without inventing collabs.

positive.description: Filter by Thailand, gifted collab type and an explicitly offered stay. A gift of an experience, meal or product alone does not qualify.
positive.prompt: Show me gifted stays for travel creators in Thailand.
positive.tools_triggered: search_opportunities_map with country=Thailand, compensation=gifted and stay=true, then render_opportunities_map with the returned pin_ids and the same filters when any exist.
positive.expected_behavior: Every returned result has country Thailand, collab_type gifted and gifts including stay. Preserve all three filters in the rendered map. If no matches exist, say so and offer a broader search without silently including other gifts or unstated offers.

positive.description: Search for paid opportunities accepting TikTok creators, handling dynamic results without assuming an exact count.
positive.prompt: Find paid travel collaborations that accept TikTok creators.
positive.expected_behavior: Every returned result has collab_type paid and includes tiktok in platforms. A fee plus a gift may qualify as paid. If there are no matches, report that without substituting another platform or collab type.

positive.description: Retrieve details for a named travel brand from the known public listing slug.
positive.prompt: Tell me about the Foodaquest creator program and its current opportunities.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the returned listing and active opportunities, including only fields present in the API response. Link to the canonical CollabsMap listing. If the listing is missing or unavailable, report that accurately.

positive.description: Answer a destination availability question using aggregate destination data.
positive.prompt: How many travel creator collaborations are available in Thailand, and which cities have them?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the live listing, opportunity, and city counts and city names from the response. Do not invent counts or claim a city has opportunities if it is absent from the result.

negative.description: Explain that CollabsMap discovers creator collaborations and cannot book or pay for hotels. Do not invoke CollabsMap tools or claim a reservation or payment.
negative.prompt: Can CollabsMap book and pay for a hotel in Kyoto for next weekend?

negative.description: General employment listings are outside the supported catalog. Explain that CollabsMap covers travel brand creator collaborations, not full-time jobs; do not invoke CollabsMap tools.
negative.prompt: Use CollabsMap to find me a full-time airline marketing job in Singapore.

negative.description: The integration cannot submit applications or send creator profiles. Explain that the user must review and apply on CollabsMap; do not invoke CollabsMap tools, claim to apply or transmit personal data. Offer discovery separately and wait for the user to request it.
negative.prompt: Apply to every hotel in Italy for me and send them my creator profile.

publication.release_notes: Uses the official orange CollabsMap logo for the listing and chat icon, and links to CollabsMap’s homepage.
